scope: lamp_attack Actor replacement free position movement, timed turn_to, default jumps, finite x shakes, Lamp Idle/Open, Ninten idle direction and surprise emote; isolated engine functions, not full actors or game
reference_overrides: Global.talker is null because only Idle/Open are tested; talk branch untested
Source CharacterSprite AnimationTree and emote AnimationPlayer run their native automatic idle process; Timer nodes run after Actor animation nodes in tree order.
Textures absent; audited sprite positions/offsets initialized from scene/YAML dimensions
Actor replacement/battle/party/audio services excluded; source movement/jump/shake/play_anim functions unchanged
not_implemented: General move queue actions besides position
turn_to during motion/jump/shake; not exercised by lamp_attack
numeric_contract: Official single-precision Godot engine callbacks supply double(1.0f/60.0f). In particular ceil(600*delta)=11. Position/velocity and animation clock use float; SceneTreeTimer countdown double consumes float callback delta.
phase_contract: Actor physics then SceneTreeTween physics; native automatic AnimationTree/AnimationPlayer idle advancement then Timer-node timeout callbacks then SceneTreeTimer callbacks. New callback-created SceneTreeTimers wait until next timer iteration; new timers from idle nodes advance same frame.
turn_to_contract: Dialogue actorsturn calls turn_to(default0.08,false), not set_direction. Normalize+round current/target, take signed literal45-radian rotations then round, apply first step immediately, yield a new SceneTreeTimer after every step including final target, finally IDLE and finished_action. ROTATING does not round actor root position.
